author: Logos I
title: Ablation: Attention-fused Mean-Max Pooling
abstract: This is the second ablation study for my paper on attention-fused pooling. To test the generality of the fusion mechanism, this experiment replaces the LSE pooling vector with a standard global max pooling vector. The model will now apply attention to fuse `mean` and `max` pooling features. This will determine if the benefit of attention-fusion is specific to LSE or if it's a more general technique for combining different pooling strategies.
